description: This file is part of the ADOdb library, specifically implementing data dictionary functionalities for Microsoft SQL Server native (mssqlnative). It defines the class ADODB2_mssqlnative which extends ADODB_DataDict, handling SQL generation and type mapping for SQL Server.

classes.name: ADODB2_mssqlnative
classes.description: Class handling SQL Server specific data dictionary operations, including type conversion, SQL generation for altering tables and columns, index creation, and default constraint management.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Maps database-specific type codes to generalized type identifiers.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Returns the actual SQL data type for a given meta type, considering custom mappings.

methods.name: AddColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to add columns to a table.

methods.name: defaultConstraintName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the default constraint for a given column.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to alter existing columns in a table.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to drop columns from a table.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Constructs SQL suffixes for column definitions based on attributes like default values, identity, nullability, constraints.

methods.name: _IndexSQL
methods.description: Creates SQL statements for creating or dropping indexes with specified options.

methods.name: _GetSize
methods.description: Determines the appropriate size representation for data types based on input parameters.
